title: Depth invariance under reindexing availability
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $A$ and $B$ be sets of coordinates with $A=B$, and let $T$ be a decision tree indexed by the available coordinate set $A$. Reindexing $T$ as a tree with available coordinate set $B$ leaves its depth unchanged.
